page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.cm4.4xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the Intel Xeon E5-2667 v4 processor. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this x86_64 server features 16 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. It is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place the instance largely in the average tier. Single-core CPU performance via stress-ng is weak, falling in the bottom 25%, while multi-core performance is average. Memory bandwidth tests show average read speeds for both small and large blocks, though large-block write bandwidth is weak. Standard processing tasks, such as gzip compression, bzip3 decompression, and Geekbench software compilation, consistently register average scores.

For specialized workloads, the server demonstrates average performance in database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving. Large language model inference is limited; while prompt processing and text generation for small 135M models are average, performance drops to weak for medium 7B models. Given the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource ratio, this instance is suitable for general-purpose workloads, multi-threaded applications, and standard web serving, though it presents a tradeoff in single-core execution speed and write-heavy memory operations.
